programme.title: L'énigme
programme.desc: L'étudiante Holly Teller (Elisabeth Harnois) est attirée par la mystérieuse petite ville de Riddle, en Pennsylvanie, à la recherche de son frère disparu. Contre la volonté du shérif local (Val Kilmer) et d'un ancien du village (William Sadler), elle commence à percer un mystère lié à un hôpital psychiatrique abandonné à la périphérie de la ville, découvrant un passé terrifiant que les habitants sont déterminés à garder secret.

programme.title: Transfert
programme.desc: L'ex-CIA est déterminée à comprendre ce qui est arrivé à son mari, grièvement blessé lors d'une mission.

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: Vice est un resort dans lequel les personnes peuvent assouvir leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: Sortie Mortelle
programme.desc: Des inconnus sont piégés dans une maison où un événement terrible a eu lieu il y a 100 ans.

programme.title: Pas de Chance
programme.desc: Archie est un escroc engagé par un propriétaire de parc d'attractions pour assassiner sa femme.

programme.title: La destination de Noël
programme.desc: Emma, dirigeante épuisée d'une entreprise de jouets, rêve d'échapper à Noël. Mais une erreur d'avion l'emmène dans une ville d'Alaska entièrement dédiée aux fêtes, où Connor pourrait lui redonner goût à Noël.

programme.title: L'amour sur mesure
programme.desc: La propriétaire d'une boutique de robes de mariée d'occasion aide les futures mariées à réaliser leurs rêves. Mais lorsqu'elle rencontre l'homme idéal, elle hésite à offrir une seconde chance à son propre cœur.

programme.title: Un Noël à New York
programme.desc: Depuis un chagrin d'amour, Marie a perdu l'esprit de Noël. Une mystérieuse boîte de décorations semble pourtant ramener la magie dans sa vie… jusqu'au retour inattendu de son ex.

programme.title: Un Noël créatif
programme.desc: Harper, illustratrice en herbe, aide un auteur célèbre mais en panne d'inspiration dans une petite ville du Colorado pendant Noël. Entre créativité et festivités, une romance inattendue naît peu à peu.

programme.title: La plus belle étoile de Noël
programme.desc: De retour dans sa ville pour Noël, Vanessa, médecin dévouée, hésite entre une promotion prestigieuse et la clinique familiale. Entre ancienne romance et attachement à sa communauté, son cœur balance.

programme.title: Chair De Poule
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon déménage avec sa mère et sa soeur dans la petite ville de Greendale, dans le Maryland. Sur place, il rencontre l'écrivain RL Stine, auteur à succès de romans d'épouvante pour adolescents…

programme.title: Hôtel Transylvanie 3 : Des Vacances Monstrueuses
programme.desc: Dans HÔTEL TRANSYLVANIE 3 : DES VACANCES MONSTRUEUSES, notre famille de monstres préférée s'embarque pour une croisière de rêve afin que Drac puisse enfin souffler un peu et savourer des vacances au lieu de s'occuper de tout le monde à l'hôtel. Tout s'annonce à merveille pour la petite famille, entre matchs de volley monstres, excursions exotiques et séances de bronzette au clair de lune… Mais Mavis se rend compte que Drac est tombé sous le charme de la mystérieuse Ericka, la capitaine du navire, dont le terrible secret pourrait bien transformer les vacances idéales en un monstrueux cauchemar…

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard
programme.desc: Lorsque Paul Crewe, star du football américain, se retrouve en prison pour fraude sur les matchs, il ne veut plus rien avoir à faire avec ce sport. Mais les gardiens l'obligent à monter une équipe avec les autres détenus. D'un groupe de hors-la-loi disparate, Crewe doit faire une équipe capable d'affronter les gardiens décidés à en découdre.

programme.title: Annie (2014)
programme.desc: Annie rencontre par le plus pur des hasards un milliardaire, Will Stacks, bientôt pris d'affection pour la fillette qu'il désire rapidement adopter. Mais Annie rêve toujours de rencontrer ses vrais parents, disparus dans un incendie des années plus tôt et dont elle ignore le décès. Ce qui va inciter un couple de truands, Rooster et Lily, appâtés par une promesse de récompense et encouragés par Miss Hannigan, la sœur de Rooster, à se faire passer pour les parents de la petite.

programme.title: Simplement irrésistible
programme.desc: Un cadre d'un grand magasin essaye de ne pas tomber amoureux d'une jeune femme qui, selon lui, acquiert des pouvoirs magiques depuis qu'elle a hérité d'un restaurant.

programme.title: L'Arnaqueuse
programme.desc: Peg Dahl est une jeune femme qui espère quitter sa ville natale de Buffalo. Elle se lance dans le business du recouvrement de dettes. La guerre est déclarée avec le Roi des chasseurs de dettes de Buffalo.

programme.title: Espion et Demi
programme.desc: Lorsque le prototype d'un avion espion des plus sophistiqués est dérobé au gouvernement américain, l'agent Alex Scott, est appelé en urgence. Il doit faire équipe avec un civil, Kelly Robinson, champion du monde de boxe très suffisant et sûr de lui mais sans expérience de l'espionnage.

programme.title: Toy Boy
programme.desc: Son job, c'est donner du plaisir!

programme.title: Les Pistoleros du Nevada
programme.desc: Deux hommes armés arrivent dans une ville avec l'intention de toucher une importante prime, mais se retrouvent pris dans une guerre locale pour le contrôle des terres.

programme.title: Les âmes damnées de Rio Chico
programme.desc: Jeff Cameron est Tom Carter, un homme qui a pour mission de venger son frère Jerry, abattu après avoir retiré toutes ses économies de la banque de la ville de Rio Canyon.

programme.title: Jack l'Éclair
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane est un hors-la-loi australien dans l'Ouest sauvage.

programme.title: La Chevauchée fantastique
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes voyageant en diligence voit son voyage compliqué par la menace de Geronimo et apprend quelque chose sur les autres au passage.

programme.title: 2 frères appelés Trinita
programme.desc: Après avoir hérité d'un terrain dans un endroit poussiéreux appelé Trinity, les demi-frères antagonistes, Lester et Jesse, se réunissent pour poursuivre des aspirations différentes

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: Planques toi minable, Trinita arrive...
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives d'escroquerie infructueuses, l'escroc Jonathan Duke et son partenaire Sebastian Carter font équipe avec Ringo et sa bande pour dévaliser le général mexicain Eldorado.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Comme c'est souvent le cas dans Bonanza, les choses ne sont pas toujours ce qu'elles semblent être au premier abord. Hoss et Adam finissent par apprendre qui est le bon et qui ne l'est pas.

programme.title: A Soldier's Revenge
programme.desc: Hanté par les horreurs de la guerre, Frank Connor, soldat de la guerre de Sécession devenu chasseur de primes, passe son temps après la guerre à s'occuper de deux choses : le whisky et les fugitifs.

programme.title: Lacérés
programme.desc: La légende locale veut qu'une femme parcoure les bois à la recherche d'un joli visage pour remplacer le trou vide où le sien a été brutalement arraché. Ce soir, une famille a installé son campement dans ces mêmes bois, et ils sont sur le point de découvrir que l'histoire du tueur sans visage n'est pas un simple récit de feu de camp... Peuvent-ils échapper à la puissance d'arrachage violente de leur visage ?

programme.title: Seisme Imminent
programme.desc: Un pirate informatique mécontent utilise le fils rebelle du président d'une grande société de logiciels pour créer Havoc.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Trois jeunes voyagent à travers la campagne hongroise dans l'espoir d'étayer la thèse au sujet de la légendaire Comtesse Elizabeth Bathory, réputée pour s'être baignée dans le sang au XVIIème siècle. Mais ils se perdent sur le retour, jusqu'à ce qu'une étrange jeune femme leur propose de les conduire au château Bathory.

programme.title: La Nuit de tous les mysteres
programme.desc: L'excentrique millionnaire Fredrick Loren et sa quatrième épouse, Annabelle, ont invité cinq personnes à passer la nuit dans leur maison de la Colline Hantée pour une soirée maison hantée . Quiconque y passera la nuit remportera dix mille dollars. Au fil de la nuit, les invités se retrouvent piégés dans la maison, confrontés à des fantômes, des meurtriers et autres créatures terrifiantes.

programme.title: Alien Invasion : L'Éveil du Phénix
programme.desc: Une pluie d'astéroïdes frappe une station spatiale, puis atterrit dans une zone reculée du Grand Canyon. Des capsules mystérieuses se forment et mutent rapidement en créatures menaçant la station spatiale et la Terre.

programme.title: Monster Hunters
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un navire extraterrestre s'écrase dans le désert californien, le seul espoir d'arrêter les extraterrestres repose sur une branche secrète du gouvernement spécialisée dans les armes extraterrestres.

programme.title: Storm Chasers
programme.desc: Un ingénieur négligé est envoyé en Alaska pour vérifier l'affirmation d'un scientifique excentrique selon laquelle la capture de la foudre peut constituer une nouvelle source d'énergie renouvelable.

programme.title: Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, un agent-assassin d'une organisation secrète au service d'un gouvernement totalitaire échoue dans une mission et doit fuir ses employeurs.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: La présidente doit choisir entre sauver son frère, pilote d'un avion détourné, ou protéger la population.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs: Nécros
programme.desc: Pendant Mardi Gras à La Nouvelle-Orléans, William Cobb vit une nuit de passion avec une femme mystérieuse accompagnée d'un vieil homme.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre
programme.desc: Maiya traverse des phases dimensionnelles, Augur et Liam veulent fusionner les univers, et Jonathan Doors lance sa candidature.

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Accusé du meurtre d'un télévangéliste, Robocop devient fugitif et mène sa propre enquête pour retrouver le vrai coupable.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs: Nécros
programme.desc: Pendant Mardi Gras à La Nouvelle-Orléans, William Cobb vit une nuit de passion avec une femme mystérieuse accompagnée d'un vieil homme.

programme.title: Farscape: À la recherche de la princesse : Je pense donc j'agis
programme.desc: La fiancée de Crichton révèle ses talents d'agent secret, tandis qu'il hésite entre devenir statue ou redevenir fugitif.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre
programme.desc: Un Jaridien prend Lili en otage. Avec Liam, ils doivent survivre dans un vaisseau Kimera pour en sortir.

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Une drogue cachée dans des pilules amaigrissantes rend les habitants de Delta City violents. Robocop doit enrayer l'épidémie.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: Présentation du film Le Roi Arthur
programme.desc: Présentation du film Le Roi Arthur

programme.title: Le Roi Arthur : Le Pouvoir d'Excalibur
programme.desc: Le roi Arthur mourant confie Excalibur à un chevalier loyal, tandis que ses fils s'affrontent.

programme.title: Présentation du film Legionnaire
programme.desc: Présentation du film Legionnaire

programme.title: Legionnaire's Trail
programme.desc: Noreno, métis romain, traverse les montagnes enneigées d'Arménie afin de trouver du secours pour ses hommes mourants.

programme.title: Oro: La Cité Perdue
programme.desc: 1538, au cœur de l'Amazonie sauvage, un groupe de conquistadors espagnols part à la recherche d'une mythique cité d'or : Teziutlan. Aveuglés par leur quête et leur soif de richesse, ils plongent au plus profond de l'enfer vert, jusqu'à en perdre la raison.

programme.title: Le roi des Rats
programme.desc: Un groupe de rats mutants attaque des êtres humains.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: Grizzly
programme.desc: Lorsque le minivan transportant deux couples tombe en panne, leur présence attire un ours agressif.

programme.title: Mutant Tiger Chronicles
programme.desc: Chine, 560 après J.-C. Un étrange virus infecte des tigres assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: Chloé et Théo
programme.desc: Un Inuit se rend à New York afin d'ouvrir les yeux des gens sur le réchauffement climatique.

programme.title: A l'ombre des regards
programme.desc: Holly se laisse dépérir depuis la mort de sa mère jusqu'à sa rencontre avec Shane.

programme.title: Hot Summer nights
programme.desc: Années 80. Vacances d'été. Un adolescent fait la fête, tombe amoureux, prend des risques..

programme.title: Judicial Indiscretion
programme.desc: Juge nommée à la Cour suprême, Monica Barrett est la cible d'un psychopathe.

programme.title: Le bal des folles
programme.desc: Au 19e siècle, une femme qui a le don unique d'entendre et de voir les morts est internée dans un asile psychiatrique, sans possibilité de s'échapper.

programme.title: Hours
programme.desc: Eté 2005. L'ouragan Katrina dévaste la Nouvelle-Orléans. Nolan Hayes emmène aux urgences son épouse enceinte. Sa vie bascule lorsqu'il apprend son décès et découvre son enfant prématuré. Nolan se retrouve seul et doit veiller sur sa fille, maintenue en vie dans une couveuse...

programme.title: L'Ultime Sacrifice
programme.desc: William Pitsenbarger est un médecin de l'armée de l'air, qui a sauvé plus de soixante soldats lors de la bataille la plus sanglante de la guerre du Vietnam. 32 ans plus tard, ses proches s'associent à un enquêteur pour tenter de lui faire décerner la médaille d'honneur du Congrès.

programme.title: La fille dans le parc
programme.desc: Quinze ans après que sa fille de trois ans ait disparu, Julia Sandburg rencontre Louise, une jeune fille au passé trouble. L'espoir renaît alors pour Julia qui veut croire que Louise peut être sa fille perdue.

programme.title: Ted Bundy : American Boogeyman
programme.desc: McChesney et Ressler mènent la plus vaste chasse à l'homme contre un tueur en série.

programme.title: Free Fall
programme.desc: Le réparateur Maksim Bortnikov se retrouve seul dans l'espace après une éruption solaire.

programme.title: Alerte Tsunamis
programme.desc: La première frappet, puis une autre d'immenses vagues engloutissent tout, et le pire arrive.

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: Cinq hommes mariés se partagent secrètement un loft à New York pour assouvir tous leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: Code Ennemi
programme.desc: Emerson est un agent du FBI relegué à un poste sans grande importance après avoir refusé de suivre des ordres pendant une mission. Il doit se charger à présent de protéger Katherine ...

programme.title: Hatch
programme.desc: Quand une de ses informatrices est tuée lors d'un raid qui a mal tourné, Russell Hatch, un agent d'Interpol, devient le protecteur de son fils Jayden.

programme.title: Stalingrad (2013)
programme.desc: Dans une ville dévastée par l'armée allemande, des soldats russes déterminés se battent pour maintenir leur position dans un immeuble stratégique et se lient d'amitié avec une compatriote.

programme.title: Jade
programme.desc: Suit une femme qui s'interpose entre un puissant homme d'affaires et un chef de gang à la recherche d'un disque dur qui pourrait nuire aux activités d'Interpol. La femme doit utiliser ses compétences uniques pour récupérer le disque dur.

programme.title: Red Rock West
programme.desc: À Red Rock, Michael est pris pour un tueur à gages. Entre mensonges, argent et vrai assassin, la situation devient incontrôlable.

programme.title: Affinity
programme.desc: Bruno, ex-SEAL traumatisé, reprend les armes lorsqu'une femme mystérieuse qui lui avait redonné espoir est enlevée.

programme.title: Bloodfight
programme.desc: À Hong Kong, une Américaine agressée suit un entraînement d'arts martiaux pour entrer dans le Kumite, un tournoi clandestin sans pitié.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Swamp perd confiance en vol, Burner défie un instructeur trop compétitif et Pearly tente de retrouver son niveau.

programme.title: Rampant
programme.desc: Le Prince Ganglim, l'un des fils du roi au pouvoir, revient au royaume coréen de Joseon après de nombreuses années passées en captivité dans les geôles des Mandchous de la dynastie Qing. Des luttes pour obtenir le trône apparaissent bientôt au sein du palais royal alors qu'une épidémie transforme les humains en morts-vivants errants à la nuit tombée...

programme.title: Psycho Goreman
programme.desc: Après avoir déterré un joyau qui contrôle un monstre maléfique cherchant à détruire l'Univers, une jeune fille et son frère l'utilisent pour lui faire faire ce qu'ils veulent.

programme.title: Inunaki
programme.desc: Le village d'Inunaki, au Japon, est surnommé le village hurlant. Une psychiatre de la région, Kanade Morita, possède un sixième sens qui la tourmente depuis l'enfance. Un jour, son frère Yuma et sa petite amie décident de jouer à se faire peur lors d'une expédition nocturne dans le village. Sans le savoir, ils vont réveiller une terrible malédiction.

programme.title: Deadly Cargo
programme.desc: Cinq amis partent faire de la plongée sous-marine et découvrent le cadavre d'un homme flottant à la surface. Leur bateau ayant coulé peu après suite à une avarie, ils se retrouvent seuls au milieu de l'océan.

programme.title: Rottweiler
programme.desc: Laissé pour mort, un chien particulièrement féroce est réanimé et transformé par les laboratoires de l'armée en véritable cyborg.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: Prison Heart
programme.desc: Août 1978. Usine sidérurgique de Kremikovtsy.

programme.title: Nuclear Target
programme.desc: L'agent Painter, membre des forces spéciales, est envoyé en mission en Tchétchénie. Il doit y empêcher la destruction d'une centrale nucléaire par les terroristes et localiser le point de frappe pour les missiles américains. Quand il se rend compte que l'ennemi n'est pas celui qu'il croit, Painter n'a pas beaucoup de temps pour éviter la catastrophe.

programme.title: Bienvenue Dans La Jungle
programme.desc: Afin de régler une dette, Beck doit traverser la jungle amazonienne pour ramener Travis, le fils d'un riche propriétaire parti dans une chasse au trésor. Cependant après l'avoir retrouvé, le chasseur de primes va s'unir à lui pour combattre Hatcher, le gérant cruel et véreux d'une mine d'or. Les choses vont encore se compliquer lorsque les deux hommes vont tous deux s'éprendre de la belle Mariana.

programme.title: Obsessed

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women
programme.desc: Grief can make you feel unnervingly vulnerable this is how Kate Winslet reflects on losing her mum in 2017. In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix
programme.desc: As part of Little Mix, Jesy Nelson felt constantly compared to her bandmates and struggled with the pressure of being in a girl band, leading to self-esteem problems and depression. She discusses with Fearne how appearance mattered as much as talent in the music industry.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a band hoping to touch your heart - Touched! Touched is a quintet composed of guitarist D.on drummer Seung bin Kim vocalist and guitarist YunMin bassist John B.Kim and keyboardist Chae Dohyeon who are all graduates of Seoul Institute of the Arts. They are young as a band but they already have an impressive award-winning career. They won the Grand Prize at the 31st Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest in 2020 as the first band in the contest's history the Grand Prize at the 2021 Pyeongtaek National Band Comepetition the Grand Prize at the Hwaseong City Culture Foundation - RISING STAR 4U and another Grand Prize at the Gyeonggi Content Agency Indiestance. Having won three grand prizes in 2021 alone Touched is considered one of the hottest rookie bands in the Korean music scene. Also combining their intense rock energy with sensitive emotional modern rock the quintet is actively pushing their boundaries creating their own genre. In this episode Touched performs The Dawn Star Hi Bully Call Me Love is Dangerous and their cover of Blue which led them to win the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five talented artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is one of Korea's top bands MONNI! Composed of vocalist Kim Shin-eui bassist Lee In-kyoung guitarist Kong Tae-woo and drummer Jung Hun-tae the quartet made their debut in 2005 with the album One Day Light. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they quickly became known in the underground scene and soon impressed the general public through the music shows I'm A Singer Season 3 Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend King of Mask Singer and more. After a break of 7 years they released their fifth full-length album firmament in November this year. Capturing everything up in the sky from the sun to the moon to stars and light it offers a beautiful depiction of the band's identity that they have built for 17 years. In this episode MONNI performs Romantic Breeze Just so-so Tonight LOVESound as well as their new songs You were my star and Again. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out their new releases!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: In 1968, a new form of military policing was being developed in a rural area north of Los Angeles. The Los Angeles Police Department sent an observer to this unit, and he, in turn, took this knowledge back to the LAPD. This contributed to the development of the department's first Special Weapons and Tactics (S.W.A.T.) team. This CQB episode takes an historical journey to examine how this incident affected and changed police tactics around the world. Using CQB's trademark “sub-second” analysis, the program also looks at how police S.W.A.T. teams train, plan and equip themselves for the challenges of urban combat. The dramatization of a 1980s S.W.A.T. siege of a gang safe-house demonstrates the complicated challenge of protecting innocent people who might be caught in the line of fi re, as well as the specifics of the squad's training regimen, how they communicated, and the special equipment they used.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: The Bosnian War was an extraordinarily complex event, with many layers of military involvement including NATO forces, national militaries, irregular paramilitary forces, mujahedeen revolutionaries, private security companies, and international intelligence personnel. One tactic in particular struck fear into the hearts of the military and civilians alike: the use of snipers positioned in high buildings. This edition of CQB investigates this specific combat technique and how it was countered by opposing forces. Taking viewers inside a “sniper‘s den,” the program explains how this tactic was so successfully used by rebel forces – and how traditional military techniques evolved to combat it.
